description: Main source file for the XdnsSsp component, including initialization, signal handling, and command dispatch logic.

methods.name: cmd_dispatch
methods.description: Handles different command inputs to control the component, such as connect, read parameters, print memory, and cancel operations.

methods.name: _print_stack_backtrace
methods.description: Prints the current call stack to a file for debugging purposes.

methods.name: daemonize
methods.description: Turns the process into a daemon by forking and detaching from terminal.

methods.description: Handles various Unix signals, performs cleanup, and prints stack trace on critical signals.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the program, processes command-line arguments, sets up signal handlers, and runs the main loop.
